title: Remove the chirp-generation dimension factor with exact streamed phases
body:
The retained chirp generator charges d index calculations at full p-bit width. Its indices and source moduli have only ell bits, with d*ell=O(p). This supplies a width-sensitive bound and an exact additive generator, reducing the chirp/scalar row from `O(T*d*p^(1+delta))` to `O(T*p^(1+delta))`.

The phase formula is unchanged. The stream maintains each quadratic term and its forward difference, subtracts the old term on a mixed-radix carry, and makes fewer than 2T adjacent axis-record visits over T entries. The proof includes a constant-tape schedule, O(p) persistent control state, short arithmetic widths and the original lexicographic output order. No per-output scan of all axes or table of T phases is required.

The same exact residue, denominator and precision feed the retained exponential routine. Numerical errors, disk format, endpoint products and frequency convention are unchanged. Polynomial-ring products remain a separate cost.

**No higher kappa is claimed.** Only the scalar margin changes from `1-epsilon-delta` to `1-delta`; the unchanged Gaussian margin was already no larger than the old scalar margin. Exact arithmetic confirms the overall minimum is unchanged. Gaussian application, normalization and small-field exposure remain open bottlenecks toward kappa=1.

The frozen verifier passed on macOS Python 3.11/3.14 and Linux Python 3.12 with byte-identical outputs: 319 complete streams, 587,020 phase entries, 191,592 chirp/Fourier coefficient identities, 60 wide carry probes, complete-period restoration, traversal/width checks and six rejected mutations. Five source files are bound to their pinned Git bytes. Dedicated 3.11/3.14 CI is included.

Run `python -B research/streamed-chirp-phases/verify.py /absolute/new/output` using only the standard library. The verifier does not execute the numerical exponential, enormous prefixes of the wide probes, or a complete multiplier. Equality of the exact arguments transfers the retained numerical guarantee; the fixed-tape complexity is a written argument, not a Python timing claim.

Credits: the integer-mult-bounds manuscript and its authors for the chirp identity, padded-box bands and scalar interfaces; eumemic, icekylinx and Zhihao Chen for inherited outer arithmetic. New accounting, stream, proof and controls by chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance. Original licenses retained; no literature priority for elementary finite differences claimed.
